slides.texte_overlay:
Habits that make you
a much better boyfriend
Asking about her day and remembering the answer. Not just "How was work?" but "Did your presentation go well?" Details show you were really listening.
Planning dates without being asked. Once a month, book something new. It doesn't need to be expensive, it just needs to show you thought about her.
Supporting her goals out loud. Her exam, her new job, her marathon. Tell her you're proud and show up for the big moments. It means more than any gift.
Handling your share at home without being reminded. Dishes, laundry, groceries. Doing it naturally says you're a real partner at home, not a guest.
Before: our evenings felt the same. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and something new to share with her at dinner every day.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: our evenings felt the same. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. Now I have something new to share with her every day.

slides.texte_overlay: Getting along with her friends and family. Ask about them, remember names, help out. Being kind to the people she loves is a quiet gift to her too.
Saying sorry quickly and meaning it. No long excuses. "You're right, I messed up, I'll do better." Easy apologies keep small issues from growing into big ones.
